description: This file provides helper functions for establishing and managing database sessions using SQLAlchemy in a Python backend. It includes functions to construct a MySQL connection URL, get or create a global SQLAlchemy engine, generate database sessions for FastAPI dependencies, and a context manager for manual session management.

methods.name: str _build_mysql_sqlalchemy_url()
methods.description: Constructs the SQLAlchemy URL for connecting to a MySQL database based on environment variables managed through get_settings().

methods.name: Engine get_engine()
methods.description: Returns a singleton SQLAlchemy Engine instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Generator[Session,None,None] get_db()
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that yields a SQLAlchemy Session, managing cleanup with yield and finally.

methods.name: Generator[Session,None,None] db_session()
methods.description: Context manager for creating and managing a SQLAlchemy Session outside of FastAPI context, with proper commit or rollback.
